name: Default
shortDescription: Vendor-neutral home automation platform that integrates devices and services through bindings, with rules, automations and a web UI.

alerts.message: Open the app right after deploying: the first visitor creates the administrator account.
The container runs without host networking, so UPnP/mDNS device discovery on your LAN and USB sticks (Z-Wave, Zigbee) are not available. Cloud and IP-based bindings work normally.
